prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules for specific kinds of changes, as no change type has been tested at least twice.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests conducted so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -3.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Account Persistence Warning Sign In Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen with high-visibility warnings explaining that pets are tied to this exact account login. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in drops off nearly 27% of users.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Preview and Verification Screen: Insert a new verification screen before generating the final pet certificate to let users preview custom photo rendering results. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or outputting wrong visuals, and adoption step drop-off is over 39%.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Interactive Tutorial Subflow: Add an interactive walkthrough sub-flow at the end of onboarding demonstrating how to show, hide, and summon the pet on the desktop. (why: Multiple support emails reported confusion on how to control/hide the pet or pet missing on desktop screen, and finish conversion is only 64.8%.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In Post Pet Customization: Move sign-in after pet choice and customization so users build emotional investment before creating an account. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users before they even see or customize their pet, taking an average of 567s.)
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Wait Time and Status Tracker: Display a progress bar and accurate remaining time estimate on the waiting screen while pet assets render in the background. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s (over 38 minutes), leading users to believe the app stalled or failed to launch.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Clarification Copy: Rewrite headlines and choice descriptions to clearly distinguish quick preset pet adoption from custom photo pet creation. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite a 8s median, showing significant hesitation and confusion.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Technical Guidelines Hint: Add clear image requirements and framing advice hints to the photo upload screen. (why: Users complained about pet rendering errors and bad generation results in support tickets during photo upload.)
7: [finish, hint] System Tray Desktop Controls Callout Hint: Provide explicit instructions on finding the app icon in the system tray to control or unhide the desktop pet. (why: Support tickets highlight user confusion regarding how to bring back or hide pets after completing setup.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Split Card Layout for Path Selection: Reformat the choose_path screen into a side-by-side split visual card layout. (why: The wide gap between median (8s) and mean (514s) time on choose_path indicates a cluttered or unclear decision presentation.)
9: [home, notification] Background Rendering Desktop Notification Option: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen so users know they can safely minimize the window while waiting. (why: Home waiting takes 201s median and 2336s mean, causing users to close the app assuming it froze.)

scores.note: High evidence from emails and funnel, but redesign type previously showed negative lift.
Targets high drop-off step, but introducing a new screen previously decreased conversion by 3.5%.
Strong alignment with tickets and high finish drop-off, but adding a subflow incurs high implementation cost and extra friction.
Deferring sign-in builds intent before friction, though reordering requires significant flow changes.
Addresses extreme mean duration (2336s) by managing user expectations during asset rendering.
Low-cost copy tweak addressing the large gap between median and mean time on path selection.
Low cost hint targeting the step with the highest drop-off rate (39.1%) backed by support tickets.
Simple hint intervention targeting 35.2% finish step drop-off and frequent support confusion.
Layout reformat aims to resolve high mean time on path selection with moderate effort.
Helps prevent app closure during lengthy background rendering phase.
